songs.title: Butler vs Advisor
songs.style: female vocal, warm soul-funk, mid-tempo groove, clean electric piano, clear lead vocal
songs.lyrics:
[verse]
Got a job you know by heart, summarise it, draft it, done
Call the Butler, hand it over, let the Butler run
Extract the fields and write the email, check it when it's through
Low verification tax, the Butler works for you

[chorus]
Butler or Advisor, which one do you need
One will do the errand, one will help you lead
Known work, call the Butler, new work, pull a chair
Butler or Advisor, pick by task, not by flair

[verse]
Got a problem with no edges, strategy unclear
Call the Advisor, think it through, the hard part's over here
Higher verification tax, a deeper payoff too
A sparring partner for the work you've never had to do

[bridge]
But watch the Sycophancy Trap, AI agrees by default
So make it attack the plan before you call it gold
What are the three weakest points, what am I not seeing
Ask it that and mean it

[chorus]
Butler or Advisor, which one do you need
One will do the errand, one will help you lead
Known work, call the Butler, new work, pull a chair
Butler or Advisor, pick by task, not by flair
key_phrases: pick by task, not by flair

songs.title: The Verification Dial
songs.style: male vocal, driving new-wave rock, steady drums, bright guitars, clear diction
songs.lyrics:
[verse]
Stakes set the floor, if an error would hurt
You stay at a hundred, you check every word
Track record moves it, the routine earns its way
Every line, then one in two, then one in five a day

[chorus]
Turn the dial, turn the dial, earn your way down
From a hundred percent, one notch at a time
New task, new dial, it starts at the top
Errors reset it, one miss and you check the lot

[verse]
Here's the verification tax, the time you saved
Minus all the checking, that's the number that you made
If the checking takes as long as doing it by hand
The return is zero, and that's the sum you'll have to stand

[bridge]
Honest sampling, random and scheduled
Checking what looks dodgy doesn't count at all
It ran is not it worked, did the email land
Was the invoice paid, did the record change

[chorus]
Turn the dial, turn the dial, earn your way down
From a hundred percent, one notch at a time
New task, new dial, it starts at the top
Errors reset it, one miss and you check the lot
key_phrases: It ran is not it worked

songs.title: The Pipeline Problem
songs.style: female vocal, gentle acoustic folk ballad, fingerpicked guitar, soft strings, slow tempo
songs.lyrics:
[verse]
Every first draft that I wrote, every red line on the page
Every small mistake they caught when I was young and underpaid
That's where judgement came from, slow and supervised
Junior work is how people become senior, by and by

[chorus]
Automate all of it and nobody gets there
The ladder's gone, the rungs are cut, and no one's climbing stairs
Cut the drudgery, keep the core
The pipeline's how the seniors grow, so don't close the door

[verse]
Saves us money now, they said, the admin's done by noon
But a decade on who signs the work, who knows the craft, who's who
Strip out every first review, every lesson learned
And the seniors that you need will never have their turn

[bridge]
Automate deliberately
Cut the pure drudgery
Keep the developmental core
And the pipeline stays intact

[chorus]
Automate all of it and nobody gets there
The ladder's gone, the rungs are cut, and no one's climbing stairs
Cut the drudgery, keep the core
The pipeline's how the seniors grow, so don't close the door
key_phrases: Junior work is how people become senior
Cut the drudgery, keep the core

songs.title: The Boring AI Manifesto
songs.style: male vocal, deadpan synth-pop, tight drum machine, warm analogue synths, dry humour, clear vocal
songs.lyrics:
[verse]
Nobody wants the headline, the robot on the stage
Give me the Friday-afternoon work that drains us every week
Internal and repetitive, and easy to verify
That's where I'm starting, and I'll tell you why

[chorus]
The most valuable AI work is boring
Boring, boring, beautifully boring
Same thing every time, so you can trust it and check it
Boring means dependable, and dependable gets it done

[verse]
Leave the clever stuff for later, let the demos fade
Start small and start internal, that's the safest bet you'll make
The spreadsheet and the inbox, the form that no one reads
Boring work's the treasure, boring's what you need

[bridge]
Use AI on dependable work first
Try the clever stuff later
Dependable first
Clever later

[chorus]
The most valuable AI work is boring
Boring, boring, beautifully boring
Same thing every time, so you can trust it and check it
Boring means dependable, and dependable gets it done
key_phrases: The most valuable AI work is boring

songs.title: The Amplification Problem
songs.style: female vocal, electronic dance pop, building synths, four-on-the-floor beat, crisp lead vocal
songs.lyrics:
[verse]
You fed it the folder called Final_FINAL_v7
Three versions of the truth and none of them correct
It read them all and answered, sure and fast and loud
Your old mistakes are louder now, and spreading through the crowd

[chorus]
Garbage in, garbage out
Faster, at scale, and with confidence
Garbage in, garbage out
Output's capped by what you put in

[verse]
It doesn't know the policy you changed in March
It only knows the files you gave, so it repeats the old
AI takes bad inputs and it scales them up for you
The quality of what comes out is capped by what goes through

[bridge]
So the fix comes before the AI
Clean datasets, current and approved
Machine-readable documents
And only those

[chorus]
Garbage in, garbage out
Faster, at scale, and with confidence
Garbage in, garbage out
Output's capped by what you put in
key_phrases: Output's capped by what you put in
